description: This Java class defines the response to a 'ModifyFeatureProperty' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances based on JSON input, managing response status, and accessing modified feature property details.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a 'ModifyFeatureProperty' command, including status, feature ID, property pointer, and optional value.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a feature property was created, with HTTP status 201.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a feature property was modified, with HTTP status 204.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyFeaturePropertyResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the modified feature property.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose property was modified.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertyValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature property value, if present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity (feature property value) according to the specified JSON schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path of the modified feature property.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the response data to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with updated Ditto headers.
